gaps.sentence: The company has made huge ___ (INVEST) in training.
The bridge is an ___ (IMPRESS) piece of engineering.
gaps.explanation: The bridge impresses people: it is impressive.

gaps.sentence: The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
The hotel is ___ (CONVENIENT) situated near the station.
gaps.explanation: 'Conveniently situated' — the adverb modifies the participle.

gaps.sentence: Her ___ (ANALYSE) of the data took three weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'Analysis' is the noun for a detailed examination; an 'analyst' is a person.

gaps.sentence: The novel is a ___ (FICTION) account of real events.
There is no ___ (PROVE) that he was anywhere near the bank.
gaps.explanation: 'No proof that …' — the noun for evidence.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
